subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose agent-scoped catalog creation through SessionCatalogProvider.resolveCreateSession and sessions.create.catalogId, with the Gateway pinning plugin-owned model and runtime policy onto created sessions?
rationale: Correctness review cannot determine whether this new public plugin and Gateway contract, including locked session ownership semantics, is the intended long-term product API.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Retain the generic optional API and server-authoritative policy, resolve conflicts, and require fresh exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the sidebar work
options.body: Keep per-agent creation and hierarchy improvements while removing catalog creation until its API design is approved separately.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Do not merge the catalog-creation path until maintainers select a different ownership or protocol design.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Retain the generic optional API and server-authoritative policy, resolve conflicts, and require fresh exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only named MEMBER-associated participant available in the evidence and have carried the API and policy design throughout the review cycles.
